Our project plan is phased to deliver six regional sites with consistent engineering governance, while acknowledging that our evidenced delivery timelines for comparable enterprise deployments are typically 15–36 months end-to-end depending on scope and rollout complexity [CAP-042] [CAP-009] [CAP-033]. For PITB, we will compress overall delivery through parallel site execution and a standardised, repeatable build baseline managed under our ISO 9001 quality and ISO 27001 security management systems [CO-PROFILE].

Phased plan and indicative timeline (from Notice to Proceed):
1) Mobilisation & governance (Weeks 1–2): kick-off, stakeholder alignment, site access plan, risk register, implementation method statements, and security controls aligned to ISO 27001 [CO-PROFILE].
2) Detailed design & bill-of-material finalisation (Weeks 3–5): redundant core design with documented high-availability methodology, IP/VLAN/routing standards, firewall policy framework, and cutover plan [CAP-021] [CO-PROFILE].
3) Procurement & staging (Weeks 4–10, overlapping): factory staging, configuration templates, and pre-acceptance test scripts. Note: our library does not yet evidence “single OEM + valid partner/reseller authorisation”; we will address this by securing the required OEM authorisation for the proposed active equipment prior to contract award.
4) Site readiness, cabling & fibre backbone (Weeks 6–14): structured cabling/fibre installation coordinated with PITB site windows.
5) Deployment & commissioning (Weeks 10–18): rollout in two waves (3+3 offices), with controlled change windows and rollback procedures.
6) Centralised monitoring/management & handover (Weeks 16–20): monitoring platform integration, alerting/reporting dashboards (to be finalised with PITB; current evidence is partial), knowledge transfer and admin training [CO-PROFILE].

Warranty & support (12 months): we will provide on-site warranty support and a 24x7 helpdesk model; our evidenced SLAs are 24–48h response, and we will close the 4-hour on-site critical-response requirement via an enhanced staffing/on-call arrangement agreed at contract finalisation [CO-PROFILE].
